review.result: conditional offline-only acceptance; distinct Ed25519 public keys required across host, Helius checker and Sol reviewer roles

verified_properties: transitive predecessor terminal time, gaps, and unknown intervals are preserved and successor times cannot overlap
plan kind, first anchor, bucket expiry, and source digest shapes fail closed
daily request and full lease byte bounds charge every UTC day intersected by each half-open bucket
storage runway uses full lease caps and binds signed free-space evidence to caller-pinned capture path, device, inode, and filesystem
churn reserve and clock source are explicit out-of-band reviewed/pinned values
Helius method counts and units are recomputed from a signed plan-specific price table with canonical unit and independent out-of-band source/table hashes
claim uniqueness is serialized in one configured owner-local registry by predecessor terminal hash, including distinct-packet concurrency and crash-prefix fail-closed behavior
historical claim verification reports eligible_at_claim while current eligible remains false
trust store rejects reuse of an Ed25519 public key across attestor/reviewer roles
limitations: offline eligibility only; activation_authorized is always false and current calendar/bridge/runtime does not consume this gate
no actual trust root, Helius charge account evidence, or production charge table was supplied; test keys and price tables are synthetic
local registry coordinates only callers using the same owner-local durable root; cross-host exclusion is not established
a future runtime adapter must independently consume the same pinned capture root and undergo a separate Sol activation review
full lease raw/stored byte caps are charged to every intersected bucket/day and can conservatively reject larger schedules
host signatures bind claims but do not prove host/provider/reviewer truth or completeness
